name: Mitsuke (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Mitsuke city emblem in yellow: a ring with three pointed rays enclosing a ring, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Mitsuke, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 2019; the emblem dates from 1 April 1962.

features.role: Mitsuke city emblem — a ring with three pointed rays enclosing a ring, like a stylised character
